title: Electrical Appliances: 42V 2A
hazard: Electric_Shock, Fire. The plug face does not meet dimensional requirements, and the supplied fuse is considered counterfeit and lacks the required ballast. As a result, the product may not be adequately protected under fault conditions, which could cause overheating and lead to a fire.
description: Black 42 V charger for electric scooters, hoverboards and electric bicycles. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

title: Hobby Sports Equipment: Electric Bike
hazard: Fire. There is no sufficient technical documentation for the product and no evidence of production control. In the absence of evidence to demonstrate the conformity of the product, it may be possible for it to overheat and catch fire. Furthermore, the product was supplied with an additional non-compliant two-pin plug, which could lead to overheating and fire.
description: Electric bicycle with a wall plug and charger. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Machinery Directive.
remedy: Import Rejected At Border; Removal From Online Marketplace
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland

title: Electrical Appliances: Chargeur Rapide 20W avec Port USB
hazard: Electric_Shock. The product lacks adequate insulation between the primary and secondary circuits. The secondary USB ports and the connected cable can become live under mains voltage. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock.
description: USB charger with: Input voltage: 100-240 V AC Output: 5 V DC / 9 V DC / 12 V DC Power or current output: 3 A / 2.22 A / 1.67 A Class II protection against electric shocks. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

title: Electrical Appliances: Girlanda
hazard: Electric_Shock. The live parts of the lamp cap are accessible when the lamp is partially screwed into the lampholder of the luminaire, leading to electric shock. Consequently, the user could touch accessible live parts and receive an electric shock.
description: LED-lighting chain. AC Mains pluggable with non-detachable power supply cord, class II, 16 A round plug. E27 lamp holders. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive and the relevant European standard EN IEC 60598.

title: Machinery: Rechargeable Grass Mower
hazard: Electric_Shock. Due to inadequate insulation between the input and output circuits of the product, the user can receive an electric shock from easily accessible live parts.
description: Electric lithium-ion battery powered lawn mower with attached wall plug. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Machinery Directive.
country: United Kingdom in respect of Northern Ireland
